item.title: A message from the Cafeteria:
item.description: Come down to the cafeteria today for a small chocolate milk or coffee and blueberry muffin for $5.00

item.title: A message from Mr. Charlebois:
item.description: Anyone interested in running cross country this year, please make your way to room 106 at 2:20. Today will be our last tryouts.

item.title: A message from the Main Office:
item.description: A reminder to students that the lock on their lockers must be locked when not in use.

item.title: A message from Ms. Clune:
item.description: Any Grade 7 & 8 students interested in joining the cross country team this year, please come to Room 144 at the start of lunch recess today for a quick meeting. Hope to see you there!

item.title: A Message from Mme. Perron:
item.description: There will be a brief Europe Trip meeting in Room 125 on THURSDAY at 1040. Please bring any items collected for the silent auction with you at this time. All travelers must attend this short meeting. Thank you!

item.title: A message from Mr. Kwok:
item.description: A reminder of the first high school girls soccer tryout today after school from 2:30-3:30. Please bring your completed participation form. If you can't make it, please reach out to Mr. Kwok

item.title: A message from Mr. Brookes:
item.description: There will be a brief meeting for any Grade 11 or 12 Student interested in running for Student Council President or VIce President today at the beginning of lunch in Room 226.
